REST API Quick Tester

Send GET/POST/PUT/DELETE requests from your browser and inspect status, timing, headers and body.

Honest note: Only works with CORS-enabled endpoints; browser blocks others. If the server does not send Access-Control-Allow-Origin, the browser refuses the request and this tool cannot work around it.

📖 How to use

  1. Enter the endpoint URL and choose the method.
  2. Add headers and a request body if needed.
  3. Click Send and inspect status, time, headers and body.
  4. Note: only CORS-enabled endpoints can be tested from a browser.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Why do I get a network/CORS error?

Browsers block cross-origin requests unless the server sends CORS headers (Access-Control-Allow-Origin). The request never left your browser — this is a browser security rule, not a tool bug.

Is my data sent anywhere else?

No — requests go directly from your browser to the URL you entered.

Can I test authenticated endpoints?

Yes — add an Authorization header. Credentials are only sent to the URL you typed.

What does the timing measure?

Wall-clock time from fetch start to the full response body being read, in milliseconds.
